Description: Lunata (inspired by moonlight) is a new medical practice with a progressive approach to plastic surgery in Berkeley, California. Dr. Kasra Eliasieh is an oculofacial plastic and reconstructive surgeon specializing in minimal and non-invasive ‘light touch’ procedures of the eyelids and face. He has refined his understanding of the eyes and facial anatomy working in the San Francisco Bay Area for more than ten years. Dr. Eliasieh will continue to offer his light touch services at Lunata, but with a deeper sense of purpose. He has co-founded Lunata with his wife Laura Eliasieh to be a trailblazer in forging a healthier relationship with the unique qualities of your existence at every age. Lunata is an inclusive and age positive medical practice, individualizing services to refresh the function and appearance of your eyelids and face with swift healing and results that age naturally. A broader commitment to sustainability will help transform the healthcare and beauty industries to be more positive for both people and the planet. We can make a difference for the planet by limiting the use of plastics in our office and supporting the development of new bio-based alternatives.
